questions.analysis_html: \begin{array}{l} \text {解答首先令} u_{n}=\frac{1}{\left[\ln(n+1)\right]^{n}}, \quad \lim_{n\rightarrow\infty}\sqrt[n]{u_{n}}=\lim_{n\rightarrow\infty}\frac{1}{\ln(n+1)}=0<1, \text {所以级数} \\ \sum_{n=1}^{\infty}\frac{1}{\left[\ln(n+1)\right]^{n}}\text {收敛. 其次, 设} f(x)=\frac{1}{(x+2)\ln(x+2)}, \text {显然,} f(x) \text {在} x>1 \text {时非负} \\ \text {且且连续, 因} f^{\prime}(x)<0, \text {所以} f(x) \text {单调减少,} \int_{1}^{\infty} f(x)dx=\lim_{\lambda\rightarrow\infty}\ln(x+2)|_{1}^{d}=\infty, \\ \text {所以级数} \sum_{n=1}^{\infty}\frac{1}{(n+2)\ln(n+2)}\text {发散. 再次, 令} u_{n}=\frac{n^{n+1}}{(n+1)!}, \text {由于} \lim_{n\rightarrow\infty}u_{n}=\infty, \text {所以级} \\ \text {数} \sum_{n=1}^{\infty}(-1)^{n}\frac{n^{n+1}}{(n+1)!}\text {发散. 最后, 令} u_{n}=\sqrt{\frac{n+1}{n}}, \text {由于} \lim_{n\rightarrow\infty}u_{n}=1, \text {所以级数} \sum_{n=1}^{\infty}\sqrt[n]{\frac{n+1}{n}}\text {发散}. \end{array}

questions.analysis_html: \begin{aligned}&\text{解答(1)研究反常积分}\\&\int_{3}^{+\infty}\frac{dx}{x(\ln x)^{3}}=\lim_{n\rightarrow+\infty}\int_{3}^{n}\frac{d\ln x}{(\ln x)^{3}}=\lim_{n\rightarrow+\infty}\frac{1}{2}((\ln 3)^{-2}-(\ln n)^{-2})=\frac{1}{2}(\ln 3)^{-2},\text{所以反常积分}\\&\int_{3}^{+\infty}\frac{dx}{x(\ln x)^{3}}\text{收敛，故级数}\sum_{n=3}^{\infty}\frac{1}{n(\ln n)^{3}}\text{收敛，又由于}\frac{1}{(n+1)(\ln n)^{3}}<\frac{1}{n(\ln n)^{3}}(n\geq3),\\&\text{由比较审敛法知级数}\sum_{n=3}^{\infty}\frac{1}{(n+1)(\ln n)^{3}}\text{收敛};\\&(2)\text{研究反常积分}\\&\int_{1}^{+\infty}\frac{\ln x\,dx}{x^{2}}=\int_{1}^{+\infty}\ln x\,d(-\frac{1}{x})=-\frac{\ln x}{x}\bigg|_{1}^{+\infty}+\int_{1}^{+\infty}\frac{dx}{x^{2}}=-\frac{1}{x}\bigg|_{1}^{+\infty}=1,\text{所以反常积分}\int_{1}^{+\infty}\frac{\ln x\,dx}{x^{2}}\text{收敛，从而由积分审敛法知级数}\sum_{n=1}^{\infty}\frac{\ln n}{n^{2}}\text{收敛，又由于}\frac{\ln n}{n^{3}+1}\leq\frac{\ln n}{n^{2}},\text{由比较审敛法知级数}\sum_{n=1}^{\infty}\frac{\ln n}{n^{2}+1}\text{收敛}.\end{aligned}

questions.analysis_html: \begin{aligned}&\text{解答(1)令}u_{n}=\frac{n^{2}}{(n+\frac{1}{n})^{n}}\ ,\ \text{则}\lim_{n\rightarrow\infty}\sqrt[n]{u_{n}}=\lim_{n\rightarrow\infty}\frac{\sqrt[n]{n^{2}}}{n+\frac{1}{n}}=0<1\ ,\ \text{由根值审敛法知}\\&\sum_{n=2}^{\infty}\frac{n^{2}}{(n+\frac{1}{n})^{n}}\text{收敛；(2)研究反常积分}\\&\int_{1}^{+\infty}\frac{\ln x\,dx}{x^{2}}=\int_{1}^{+\infty}\ln x\,d(-\frac{1}{x})=-\frac{\ln x}{x}\Bigg|_{1}^{+\infty}+\int_{1}^{+\infty}\frac{dx}{x^{2}}=-\frac{1}{x}\Bigg|_{1}^{+\infty}=1\ ,\ \text{所以反常积分}\\&\int_{1}^{+\infty}\frac{\ln x\,dx}{x^{2}}\text{收敛，从而由积分审敛法知级数}\sum_{n=1}^{\infty}\frac{\ln n}{n^{2}}\text{收敛}.\end{aligned}

questions.analysis_html: \begin{array}{l} \text {解答当} p \leq 0 \text {时,} \frac{1}{n (\ln n)^{p}} \geq \frac{1}{n} (n \geq 3), \text {由于级数} \sum_{n=3}^{\infty} \frac{1}{n} \text {发散,由比较审敛法知,} \\ \text {级数} \sum_{n=3}^{\infty} \frac{1}{n (\ln n)^{p}} \text {发散;当} p = 1 \text {时,因为} \lim_{n \to \infty} \int_{3}^{x} \frac{d x}{x \ln x} = \lim_{n \to \infty} (\ln \ln n - \ln \ln 3) = + \infty, \\ \text {故对} f(x) = \frac{1}{x \ln x} \text {用积分审敛法知级数} \sum_{n=3}^{\infty} \frac{1}{n \ln n} \text {发散.再由比较审敛法知级数} \\ \text {于} p \leq 1 \text {时发散.当} p > 1 \text {时,因为} \\ \lim_{n \to \infty} \int_{3}^{x} \frac{d x}{x (\ln x)^{p}} = \lim_{n \to \infty} \int_{3}^{x} \frac{d \ln x}{(\ln x)^{p}} = \lim_{n \to \infty} \frac{1}{1-p} \left( (\ln n)^{1-p} - (\ln 3)^{1-p} \right) = \frac{1}{p-1} (\ln 3)^{1-p}, \\ \text {所以对} f(x) = \frac{1}{x (\ln x)^{p}} \text {用积分审敛法知所讨论级数收敛.} \end{array}

questions.analysis_html: \begin{aligned}&\text{解答(1)研究反常积分}\int_{3}^{+\infty}\frac{dx}{x\ln x}=\int_{3}^{+\infty}\frac{1}{\ln x}d\ln x=\ln(\ln x)|_{3}^{\infty}=+\infty,\text{所以反常积分}\int_{3}^{+\infty}\frac{dx}{x\ln x}\text{是发散的},\text{故级数}\sum_{n=3}^{\infty}\frac{1}{n\ln n}\text{发散},\text{由于}\frac{1}{n\ln n}<\frac{n+1}{n^{2}\ln n}(n\geq3),\text{由比较判别法知},\text{级数}\sum_{n=3}^{\infty}\frac{(n+1)}{n^{2}\ln n}\text{发散};(2)\text{研究反常积分}\\&\int_{3}^{+\infty}\frac{dx}{x(\ln x)^{2}}=\lim_{n\rightarrow+\infty}\int_{3}^{n}\frac{dx}{x(\ln x)^{2}}=\lim_{n\rightarrow+\infty}\int_{3}^{n}\frac{d\ln x}{(\ln x)^{2}}=\lim_{n\rightarrow+\infty}((\ln 3)^{-1}-(\ln n)^{-1})=(\ln 3)^{-1},\text{所以反常积分}\int_{3}^{+\infty}\frac{dx}{x(\ln x)^{2}}\text{收敛},\text{估级数}\sum_{n=3}^{\infty}\frac{1}{n(\ln n)^{2}}\text{收敛},\text{又由于}\frac{1}{(n+1)(\ln n)^{2}}<\frac{1}{n(\ln n)^{2}}(n\geq3),\text{由比较收敛法知级数}\sum_{n=3}^{\infty}\frac{1}{(n+1)(\ln n)^{2}}\text{收敛}.\end{aligned}

questions.analysis_html: \begin{aligned}&\text{解答当}p=1\text{时，原级数为}\sum_{n=1}^{\infty}\frac{\ln n}{n},\text{考查反常积分}\\&\int_{1}^{+\infty}\frac{\ln x\,dx}{x}=\int_{1}^{+\infty}\ln x\,d\ln x=\frac{(\ln x)^{2}}{2}\Bigg|_{1}^{+\infty}=+\infty,\text{反常积分}\int_{1}^{+\infty}\frac{\ln x\,dx}{x}\text{发散，由积分审敛法知级数}\sum_{n=1}^{\infty}\frac{\ln n}{n}\text{发散；当}p<1\text{时，由于}\frac{\ln n}{n}<\frac{\ln n}{n^{p}},\text{由比较审敛法知级数}\sum_{n=1}^{\infty}\frac{\ln n}{n^{p}}\text{发散；当}p>1\text{研究反常积分}\\&\int_{1}^{+\infty}\frac{\ln x\,dx}{x^{p}}=\int_{1}^{+\infty}\ln x\,d(x^{-p+1}-\frac{x}{-p+1})=\ln x\frac{x^{-p+1}}{-p+1}\Bigg|_{1}^{+\infty}-\int_{1}^{+\infty}\frac{x^{-p}dx}{-p+1}=\frac{-1}{-p+1}\cdot\frac{x^{-p+1}}{-p+1}\Bigg|_{1}^{+\infty}=\frac{1}{(-p+1)^{2}}\\&\text{则反常积分}\int_{1}^{+\infty}\frac{\ln x\,dx}{x^{p}}\text{收敛，所以由积分审敛法知级数}\sum_{n=1}^{\infty}\frac{\ln n}{n^{p}}\text{收敛}.\end{aligned}
